note: with localBoundIP blank the oracle's listener is Netty's new InetSocketAddress(port), a dual-stack [::]:1080 (its container's /proc/net/tcp6 lists 0438 on ::), so it answers on ::1 as well as 127.0.0.1. Recorded by a self-dial inside the oracle's container: the Docker VM forwards the published port on the host's 127.0.0.1 only, so a request from the host to [::1] cannot reach it, while the container's lo carries ::1. Both the bare and the bracketed IPv6 literal are dialed; the forwarded Host header is the oracle's host:port join, '::1:1080'
